title: Vignette before and after on the talking-head edit
caption: A lens vignette on the talking-head edit, shown as a split screen: the left half is the source, the right half the vignetted file, so the darker corners that pull the eye to Mira are visible on the same frame.
prompt: Add a noticeable lens vignette (angle 0.9 rad) to 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2.5 s to 9.5 s) so the corners fall off and the eye goes to Mira. Then make a before/after split: left half the original, right half the vignetted clip, a thin cream divider and small "Before" and "After: vignette" labels in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg). Keep the audio.
commands: ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -i work/vignette.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v]crop=960:1080:0:0[l];[1:v]crop=960:1080:960:0[r];[l][r]hstack=inputs=2,drawbox=x=958:y=0:w=4:h=1080:color=0xf0eadf:t=fill[c];[c][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
